lineEndingCorrection.finding: The first parent packet matched its raw inventory but contained CRLF worker decision copies. A new text eol=lf rule alone would not rewrite those already checked-out bytes, so a later checkout could disagree with the sealed raw inventory.
lineEndingCorrection.resolution: Parent converted all three worker decisions to UTF-8 without BOM/LF, refreshed all twelve consolidated inventory records and reserialized the consolidated decision. This reviewer then independently verified the final raw decision digest and all fifty-eight inventory entries. The .gitattributes rule covers the consolidated decision and all worker/final reviews.
lineEndingCorrection.mainIntegrationObligation: Apply the same LF normalization to any already checked-out decision/review copies during main integration, then verify these raw digests. Do not rewrite the retained manifests to fit different bytes.

documentationDigestScope: UTF-8 without BOM after converting CRLF to LF. These are explicitly normalized text identities, not raw working-tree digests. They permit Git checkout line-ending conversion without claiming different raw bytes are identical.
remainingConditions: The consolidated reconsideration requirements remain required. Passing this documentary review closes no broad promotion gate and does not change source/runtime/model defaults, installation, resource admission or owner execution permissions.
